name: T cell leukemia homeobox 3
pathways: regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: TLX3 encodes t-cell leukemia homeobox protein 3. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and sequence-specific double-stranded DNA binding. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and animal organ development.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include T-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
